videos.title: Cast Iron Leaving Black Residue? It's Not Your Seasoning
videos.point: Black residue on cast iron is usually carbonized food, not a failed seasoning layer.

Soap and stiff brush remove it without stripping seasoning.
Lower heat and proper cleaning prevent buildup.
videos.watch_why: Practical mechanism and fix for a common kitchen issue.
